Incoming-message rehearsal: enable Notification access and automatic protection. Have a consenting helper send the example to this phone through a supported SMS or WhatsApp notification. Keep that conversation closed so a preview appears. Hidden previews cannot be checked. Android may require the app overlay permission and its warning switch for a full-screen interruption.

Call Shield is separate: enable its call-screening role in Protection settings on supported Android 10+ phones. Test with a consenting caller. It gives caller-ID advice; it does not hear calls or detect cloned voices.
